You may speak for as long as you wish.
What are the steps involved when people have to do laundry?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: Well, gather up the dirty clothes, then separate the light things from the dark ones. Check the pockets, put a load in the machine, add detergent and choose the wash setting. Then you dry them—hang them up or use the dryer—and fold them and put them away. Some things need a gentler wash; I usually check the label if I’m not sure.
